summary: In October 2022, one person was arrested in Kaithal, Haryana for the aggravated penetrative assault on a child. The charges also include murder, kidnapping, abduction and destroying evidence. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was convicted. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Aggravated penetrative assault on a child — Kaithal (2022) — appeal pending
